name: litmus-mcp
description: Natural-language access to Litmus Edge industrial IoT.

interface.shortDescription: Industrial IoT tools for Litmus Edge
interface.longDescription: Query devices and tags, discover and sample NATS topics, run InfluxDB historical queries, inspect digital twins, and audit Litmus Edge Manager fleets on your Litmus Edge instance via natural language. 62 tools plus a fallback over the full Litmus SDK of roughly 550 functions, with state-changing calls behind an approval gate.
defaultPrompt: List the devices on my Litmus Edge and tell me which are actually publishing
Why did device Machine3 stop reporting, and when?
Show the last hour of values for the Temperature tag on Machine3
Audit my Litmus Edge Manager fleet for expired licenses and version spread
